# Fetch all pending received payment requests, paginated
pw_venmo = [x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='venmo'][0]
venmo_username = apis.supervisor.show_profile()['email']
venmo_access_token = apis.venmo.login(username=venmo_username, password=pw_venmo)['access_token']

contact_emails = ['jo-harr@gmail.com', 'kathrynmaldonado@gmail.com', 'tr_solo@gmail.com', 'an-harrison@gmail.com', 'carbrown@gmail.com', 'diwils@gmail.com', 'hun.weaver@gmail.com', 'joseph.webe@gmail.com', 'ma_smith@gmail.com', 'mar_blac@gmail.com', 'william_mart@gmail.com']
contact_emails_set = set(contact_emails)

all_pending = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    resp = apis.venmo.show_received_payment_requests(access_token=venmo_access_token, status='pending', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('pending_fetch_page', page_index, 'count', len(resp) if resp else 0)
    if not resp:
        break
    all_pending.extend(resp)
    page_index += 1

    if sender_email in contact_emails_set:
        filtered.append(pr)

# Print verification artifact (IDs, amount, sender)
for pr in filtered:
    print('match_id', pr.get('payment_request_id'), 'amount', pr.get('amount'), 'sender_email', pr.get('sender', {}).get('email'), 'sender_name', pr.get('sender', {}).get('name'), 'created_at', pr.get('created_at'))

nonmatch_count = len(all_pending) - len(filtered)

shown=0

    sender_email = pr.get('sender', {}).get('email')

        print('nonmatch_id', pr.get('payment_request_id'), 'sender_email', sender_email, 'amount', pr.get('amount'))

        break

phone_username = apis.supervisor.show_profile()['phone_number']
phone_access_token = apis.phone.login(username=phone_username, password=phone_pw)['access_token']


def fetch_contacts_by_relationship(rel, page_limit=20):
    all_contacts=[]
    page_index=0
    while True:
        resp=apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_access_token, query='', relationship=rel, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not resp:
            break
        all_contacts.extend(resp)
        page_index += 1
        if page_index>50:
            break
    return all_contacts

roommates=fetch_contacts_by_relationship('roommate')
coworkers=fetch_contacts_by_relationship('coworker')
contact_emails_set=set([c.get('email') for c in roommates+coworkers if c.get('email')])

# Fetch all pending received payment requests
all_pending=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    resp=apis.venmo.show_received_payment_requests(access_token=venmo_access_token, status='pending', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not resp:
        break
    all_pending.extend(resp)
    page_index += 1
    if page_index>50:
        break

filtered=[pr for pr in all_pending if pr.get('sender',{}).get('email') in contact_emails_set]

print('approving_count', len(filtered))
# Approve sequentially and print responses
results=[]
for pr in filtered:
    pid=pr.get('payment_request_id')
    sender_email=pr.get('sender',{}).get('email')
    amount=pr.get('amount')
    print('approving_payment_request_id', pid, 'sender_email', sender_email, 'amount', amount)
    resp=apis.venmo.approve_payment_request(payment_request_id=pid, access_token=venmo_access_token)
    results.append((pid, resp))
    print('approve_resp_for', pid, resp)

print('done_approvals', len(results))
